items.title: Jose Mourinho goes on bizarre Vinicius Jr and Kylian Mbappe rant as he compares Real Madrid stars to FRUIT TREES
items.summary: JOSE MOURINHO went on a bizarre rant in which he compared Vinicius Jr and Kylian Mbappe to FRUIT TREES. The Real Madrid stars were booed by their own fans this week following the defeat to Real Betis on Friday. The team responded with a 2-1 win over Inter Milan in the Champions League on Tuesday...
